name: H3/H4: the hover handler ignores the window's links
why: Without _dpWinTarget() in the mouseover, a link of the window is never the hovered element, so neither Ctrl nor a rest shows its card or an image's preview.
grep: H3: a link that opens here

name: H3: Space on a window link's card opens a new path instead of opening it here
why: Space on a card of a link in the window must open it there, as a click does (the back stack keeps the release).
grep: H3: a link that opens here

name: H4: Space on an image's preview scrolls the window
why: An image's preview pins nothing and keeps the window where it is; a Space that scrolls hides the preview and the next Esc closes the window.

name: H4: Shift does not show the image larger
why: Shift held on an image's preview shows it larger.

name: H4: an image's own 250 ms delay is ignored
why: Known overlap: the fixture page sets sa_rich_tooltip_delay_ms to 0, shorter than the image's 250 ms, so no spec can see the image wait less or more. Recorded, not covered.

edits.find: const delay = typeof t.delay === 'number' ? t.delay : (typeof d === 'number' && d >= 0) ? d : 400;

name: H1: the foot line never names what is hovered
why: The window's foot line says what a click on the hovered link or image does.

name: H2: the marks are never laid
why: The links are marked by a MutationObserver on the scroll area, after every repaint.

name: H5: the read-ahead is never wanted
why: The read-ahead's request is wanted while the pointer stays on the link; without it the rate gate drops it.

name: H5: the read-ahead runs with the setting off
why: sa_dp_window_read_ahead is off by default: a rest reads nothing ahead.

name: H6: ← Back does not name where it goes
why: Back's tip names the target it returns to.
grep: H3: a link that opens here

name: H4: the cover's link spans the column
why: Without the inline-block rule the cover's link runs across the column, and the pointer beside the picture is on the link (vzell's report, 2026-10-23).

edits.find: .mb-dp-dialog a:has(> img.mb-dp-xcover) { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; vertical-align: top; }

grep: jungleland.it: the cover's preview belongs to the picture

name: H4: any point of an image link shows the preview
why: An image link counts only on its picture; without the test a link wider than its picture shows the preview, and names the viewer in the foot line, with the pointer on the empty space beside it.
grep: jungleland.it: the cover's preview belongs to the picture

name: H4: a focus opens the image's preview
why: The viewer gives the focus back to the thumbnail on closing; a preview opened by that focus takes the next Esc, so the window stays open (the full suite's failure, 2026-10-23). Both guards are reverted: with the picture as the preview's element a focus on the link could not open it either.
grep: jungleland.it: a click on a scan opens the artwork viewer

name: H4: the image's preview belongs to the link
why: With the link as the preview's element, leaving the picture for the link's empty space is not leaving it, and the preview stays.
